answer: Audits are recorded in echo, queued in zephyr, and nadir publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 66 identities per epoch. A farm of 189 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 743 identities would post 2205 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
